elevate.move: Bring approved library frames into the manual as FIG. plates in the same corner-tick frame as the drawings, pairing each step's drawing with a photo of the same moment (hands squaring a frame, a strapped dresser, flattened boxes) so stock becomes evidence inside the signature.

Make the hero the manual's cover page: the h1 carries trade + town as part of step 01, FIG. 1 closes inside 900px with the first ruled step band peeking beneath, and on 390 a cropped FIG. 1 (drawers sliding shut) sits between the h1 and the buttons.
